name: core-v2
description: Core v2 benchmark: 8 planning requests x 5 conditions (the bare request, the skill, an active-control planning skill, and length-capped versions of the bare request and the skill), 5 runs per cell, blinded judging by two judge models on two rubrics, and a leakage probe.
